name: WayriCAD Quick EMerge (beta)
description: Interactive EMerge 3+ antenna and saved-PCB rule-area simulations (beta).
description_full: Beta read-only electromagnetic workbench with antenna and PCB templates, reviewed two-layer rule-area copper extraction, native interactive 3D/2D views, original-sample probes, S-parameters, radiation and HTML/PDF reports. New studies use 81 frequency samples, an 81 x 81 field grid and two-degree radiation sampling. Offline KiCad-specific Help explains setup, ports and limitations. Documented material, boundary, network and bounded advanced study controls are included; this does not expose every upstream EMerge capability. Region studies omit components, general multilayer/via extraction and PCB outside the enclosure. An isolated dependency manager installs EMerge 3+ and qualifies updates before activation, retaining rollback. Compatibility checks do not establish numerical accuracy or convergence. Requires a saved PCB, KiCad 10 native bindings and internet for initial setup.
